rationale: The description identifies data access and integration, interactive touchscreen use, and line-of-business templates as board-meeting functions. The unspecified simulation method does not outweigh these conventional presentation and data-integration functions or establish AI.
evidence_spans: Real-time data access with cloud deployment. Seamless integration of data across all sources.
Simulate outcomes with interactive touchscreen. Leverage pre-built line-of-business templates.
conflict_response: The concern about outcome simulation's unspecified method is appropriate: the text does not establish whether it is deterministic or predictive. However, the overall description also concretely identifies real-time data access, source integration, touchscreen interaction, and templates as meaningful conventional boardroom functions. Nothing affirmatively establishes AI or makes the conventional functions dependent on it, supporting non_ai.
